items.q: ___ a cat in the garden.
items.why: There is / there are: "a cat" é singular, então "there is".

items.q: ___ three books on the table.
items.why: There is / there are: "three books" é plural, então "there are".

items.q: Is there a bank near here? — Yes, ___.
items.why: There is / there are: a resposta curta repete a estrutura: "Yes, there is."

items.q: ___ any milk in the fridge?
items.why: There is / there are: "milk" é incontável e fica no singular: "Is there any milk?"

items.q: There ___ any students in the classroom.
items.why: There is / there are: plural na negativa: "there aren't any students".

items.q: She ___ in London.
items.why: Present simple: com he/she/it o verbo ganha -s: "she lives".

items.q: ___ you like coffee?
items.why: Present simple: pergunta com I/you/we/they usa "do".

items.q: My brother ___ watch TV in the morning.
items.why: Present simple: negativa com he/she/it usa "doesn't" + verbo sem -s.

items.q: I ___ a teacher.
items.why: Present simple de be: I am, you are, he/she/it is.

items.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees.
items.why: Present simple: usado para fatos e verdades gerais; "water" é he/she/it, então "boils".

items.q: I ___ swim very well.
items.why: Can (habilidade): "can" não muda com a pessoa e vem sem "to".

items.q: She can ___ the piano.
items.why: Can (habilidade): depois de "can", verbo na forma base.

items.q: ___ you speak French?
items.why: Can (habilidade): na pergunta, "can" vem antes do sujeito.

items.q: My grandfather ___ use a computer. He never learned.
items.why: Can (habilidade): a negativa é "can't" (cannot).

items.q: Can he drive? — No, he ___.
items.why: Can (habilidade): a resposta curta repete o modal: "No, he can't."

items.q: Look! It ___.
items.why: Present continuous: ação acontecendo agora: am/is/are + -ing.

items.q: They ___ dinner right now.
items.why: Present continuous: "right now" pede be + -ing; "they" usa "are".

items.q: What ___ you doing?
items.why: Present continuous: pergunta com "are you" + -ing.

items.q: I usually walk to work, but today I ___ the bus.
items.why: Present simple x present continuous: rotina com o simple; o que é diferente hoje, com o continuous.

items.q: She ___ to music at the moment.
items.why: Present continuous: negativa com "at the moment": is not + -ing.

items.q: Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.
items.why: Past simple: "go" é irregular; o passado é "went".

items.q: We ___ a great film last night.
items.why: Past simple: verbo regular ganha -ed: "watched".

items.q: ___ you see Tom at the party?
items.why: Past simple: pergunta com "did" + verbo na forma base.

items.q: She didn't ___ the email.
items.why: Past simple: depois de "didn't", verbo na forma base.

items.q: I ___ tired after the trip.
items.why: Past simple de be: I/he/she/it was; you/we/they were.

items.q: My house is ___ than yours.
items.why: Comparativos: adjetivo curto ganha -er; consoante dobra em "big → bigger".

items.q: This is the ___ day of the year.
items.why: Superlativos: adjetivo curto ganha -est, com "the" antes.

items.q: English is ___ than Chinese for me.
items.why: Comparativos: adjetivo terminado em -y troca por -ier: "easier".

items.q: This book is ___ than the film.
items.why: Comparativos: adjetivo longo usa "more": "more interesting".

items.q: Today is ___ than yesterday.
items.why: Comparativos: "good" é irregular: good, better, the best.

items.q: Look at those clouds. It ___ rain.
items.why: Will e going to: previsão com evidência no presente usa "going to".

items.q: The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it.
items.why: Will e going to: decisão tomada na hora usa "will".

items.q: We ___ visit my aunt next weekend. We bought the tickets.
items.why: Will e going to: plano já decidido usa "going to".

items.q: I think she ___ like the present.
items.why: Will e going to: opinião sobre o futuro (I think…) costuma usar "will".

items.q: I promise I ___ tell anyone.
items.why: Will e going to: promessa usa "will"; a negativa é "won't".

items.q: I ___ TV when you called.
items.why: Past continuous: ação em andamento no passado (was/were + -ing) interrompida por outra.

items.q: What ___ you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
items.why: Past continuous: com "you" usa "were" + -ing.

items.q: While she ___, the phone rang.
items.why: Past simple x past continuous: "while" acompanha a ação longa (continuous); a curta fica no simple.

items.q: It ___ when we left the house.
items.why: Past continuous: descreve o cenário no momento de outra ação.

items.q: They ___ when the teacher came in.
items.why: Past continuous: negativa com "they": weren't + -ing.

items.q: I ___ never ___ to Japan.
items.why: Present perfect: experiência de vida sem tempo definido: have + particípio (been).

items.q: ___ you ever eaten sushi?
items.why: Present perfect: pergunta com "ever" usa "have" + particípio.

items.q: She has just ___ her homework.
items.why: Present perfect: "just" com have/has + particípio: "has just finished".

items.q: I ___ my keys yesterday.
items.why: Present perfect x past simple: com tempo definido (yesterday) usa o past simple.

items.q: We have lived here ___ 2015.
items.why: Present perfect: "since" + ponto no tempo; "for" + período (for ten years).

items.q: I ___ play football when I was a child.
items.why: Used to: hábito no passado que não existe mais: used to + verbo.

items.q: Did you ___ live in Rio?
items.why: Used to: em pergunta e negativa com "did", fica "use to" (sem -d).

items.q: She ___ like vegetables, but now she loves them.
items.why: Used to: negativa é "didn't use to".

items.q: There ___ be a cinema here.
items.why: Used to: também descreve situações antigas: "there used to be".

items.q: I'm ___ waking up early. I do it every day.
items.why: Be used to + -ing = estar acostumado; é diferente de "used to" + verbo (hábito antigo).

items.q: You ___ wear a seatbelt. It's the law.
items.why: Verbos modais: obrigação forte usa "must" (ou "have to").

items.q: You ___ see a doctor about that cough.
items.why: Verbos modais: conselho usa "should".

items.q: You ___ come if you don't want to. It's optional.
items.why: Verbos modais: "don't have to" = não é necessário; "mustn't" = é proibido.

items.q: Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
items.why: Verbos modais: possibilidade usa "might" ou "may".

items.q: ___ you help me with this box, please?
items.why: Verbos modais: pedido educado usa "could" ou "can".

items.q: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
items.why: Conditionals: first conditional (situação possível): if + present, will + verbo.

items.q: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
items.why: Conditionals: second conditional (hipótese): if + past, would + verbo; com be, usa-se "were".

items.q: If you heat ice, it ___.
items.why: Conditionals: zero conditional (verdade geral): if + present, present.

items.q: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
items.why: Conditionals: third conditional (passado que não aconteceu): if + past perfect, would have + particípio.

items.q: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
items.why: Conditionals: second conditional: a oração com "if" fica no past simple.

items.q: This house ___ in 1920.
items.why: Voz passiva: be + particípio; no passado, "was built".

items.q: English ___ all over the world.
items.why: Voz passiva: no presente, is/are + particípio: "is spoken".

items.q: The letters ___ yesterday.
items.why: Voz passiva: sujeito plural no passado: "were sent".

items.q: The new bridge will ___ next year.
items.why: Voz passiva: no futuro, will be + particípio.

items.q: The film was directed ___ Steven Spielberg.
items.why: Voz passiva: quem faz a ação vem depois de "by".

items.q: When we arrived, the film ___.
items.why: Past perfect: ação anterior a outra no passado: had + particípio.

items.q: She was tired because she ___ all day.
items.why: Past perfect: explica a causa, que aconteceu antes: had worked.

items.q: I ___ never seen snow before I went to Canada.
items.why: Past perfect: experiência anterior a um momento do passado: had never seen.

items.q: After he ___ dinner, he went to bed.
items.why: Past perfect: com "after", a primeira ação vai para o past perfect.

items.q: By the time I got to the station, the train ___.
items.why: Past perfect: "by the time" marca que a ação já tinha terminado.

items.q: I enjoy ___ books in the evening.
items.why: Gerúndio e infinitivo: depois de "enjoy" vem o -ing.

items.q: She decided ___ a new job.
items.why: Gerúndio e infinitivo: depois de "decide" vem to + verbo.

items.q: ___ is good for your health.
items.why: Gerúndio e infinitivo: o -ing funciona como sujeito da frase.

items.q: I'm interested in ___ Spanish.
items.why: Gerúndio e infinitivo: depois de preposição (in, at, of…) vem o -ing.

items.q: They want ___ early tomorrow.
items.why: Gerúndio e infinitivo: depois de "want" vem to + verbo.

items.q: "I am tired." → She said that she ___ tired.
items.why: Reported speech: o verbo recua um tempo: am → was.

items.q: "I will call you." → He said he ___ call me.
items.why: Reported speech: will → would.

items.q: "Where do you live?" → She asked me where ___.
items.why: Reported speech: pergunta indireta tem ordem de afirmação (sujeito + verbo) e o tempo recua.

items.q: "Don't touch it." → He told me ___ it.
items.why: Reported speech: ordem negativa vira "tell someone not to + verbo".

items.q: She ___ me that she was leaving.
items.why: Reported speech: "tell" pede a pessoa (told me); "say" não (said that…).

items.q: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
items.why: Modais de dedução: certeza de que algo não é verdade usa "can't".

items.q: She's been working all day. She ___ be exhausted.
items.why: Modais de dedução: certeza de que algo é verdade usa "must".

items.q: I can't find my phone. I ___ have left it at work.
items.why: Modais de dedução: sobre o passado, must have + particípio = quase certeza.

items.q: He ___ have seen us. He didn't say hello.
items.why: Modais de dedução: can't have + particípio = é impossível que tenha acontecido.

items.q: They're late. They ___ have missed the bus.
items.why: Modais de dedução: possibilidade no passado: might/may/could have + particípio.

items.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
items.why: Orações relativas: para pessoas, "who" (ou "that").

items.q: This is the book ___ I told you about.
items.why: Orações relativas: para coisas, "which" (ou "that").

items.q: That's the man ___ car was stolen.
items.why: Orações relativas: posse usa "whose".

items.q: This is the town ___ I was born.
items.why: Orações relativas: lugar usa "where".

items.q: The people ___ the meeting were very angry.
items.why: Orações relativas reduzidas: "who attended" pode virar só "attending".

items.q: Never ___ such a beautiful view.
items.why: Inversão: depois de "never" no começo da frase, auxiliar antes do sujeito.

items.q: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
items.why: Inversão: "not only" no começo pede auxiliar + sujeito.

items.q: Hardly ___ arrived when the phone rang.
items.why: Inversão: "hardly… when" usa had + sujeito + particípio.

items.q: ___ I known, I would have helped.
items.why: Inversão: "Had I known" = If I had known (condicional formal).

items.q: Only then ___ the truth.
items.why: Inversão: "only then" no começo pede did + sujeito + verbo.
